title: Messaging — Receipt — payload
description: A recipient's delivery layer tells the sender that it durably holds a message the sender asked to be receipted, by echoing the delivery id the sender stamped on it. Fire-and-forget: no response, and no receipt of a receipt.

confirms.description: The delivery id the sender stamped on the message — the TSP binding envelope's `deliveryId`, or the DIDComm binding's `delivery_id` header — echoed exactly.
